transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining the 08:00 change-control huddle. As you know, Welding Cell 5's controller firmware reaches end of vendor support this month, and we have a tentative retrofit scheduled for Friday before the next production run. Before I authorize this work, I need each function to report any relevant requirements. Controls engineering, production planning, and quality — please share what you need from your side so we can get everything on the record.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety requirement. I confirmed with the controller vendor yesterday that a safety bulletin identifies an interlock race condition in the current firmware running on Welding Cell 5. This means the retrofit is not just a support lifecycle issue — it must be completed before the cell's next production run. The work requires exactly 6 hours of energized lockout and post-update safety-I/O validation. I should also note that the vendor bulletin has not yet been attached to the work order, so we need to get that documented before authorization.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my production-capacity check results. Alternate Welding Cell 4 can produce exactly 160 of the 240 required assemblies by Friday 16:00, but the remaining 80 assemblies must be produced on Cell 5 after the retrofit completes. There's a critical timing constraint: the Cell 4 reservation expires Thursday at noon, and I have not yet entered this temporary reservation in the production system. So we need to lock in that Cell 4 capacity today, and the Cell 5 retrofit must be completed with enough time remaining on Friday to produce those final 80 assemblies.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical customer quality requirement. I verified in the customer's quality portal that exactly the first 20 assemblies produced after a controller change on Welding Cell 5 must be held for weld-macro and dimensional validation before they can be released. This requirement has not yet been copied into our local inspection plan, so we need to document it as a post-change inspection action before authorizing this retrofit. This directly impacts the Friday order — those first 20 off Cell 5 after the retrofit cannot ship until validation is complete.
transcript.speaker: A4
